description: Gibraltar Vessel Traffic (AIS) [2011] is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transport", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Derived from 2011 Automatic Identification System (AIS) broadcast returns. Each vessel count per aliquot block represents the number of vessels traveling through the block during the year of 2010. An aliquot measures 1/16 of a full OCS leasing block or 1200 x 1200 meters. Coverage: Gibraltar. It has 5 files in VECTOR. The portal files it under Transport. The portal gives 2011 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
